name: Right Stuff Equipment
description: Right Stuff Equipment is proud of to be a member of PMMI. Being a member of PMMI is not an easy process. RSE was thoroughly vetted by a PMMI member who made a visit to our facility, took an extensive tour and interviewed key staff members to confirm RSE is in fact the manufacturer of RSE Branded Equipment. There are many companies that represent themselves as a manufacturer of the equipment they sell however in most cases if they are not a PMMI member the equipment is outsourced from overseas and assembled and/or re-branded in the USA.  Our branded equipment is made in the USA in our Denver Colorado facility.
